_comment: Source list for the extraction step. hint_urls guide the extractor; it should ALSO web-search to find/verify the current manifesto + major attributable stated positions (don't trust a stale hint). Scope v1 = 2024 GE manifesto backbone + verifiable current positions. Same thoroughness for every party.
_manifesto_note: Canonical, verified per-party source for the manifesto evidence unit (M). The extractor GUESSED per-policy manifesto URLs and several 404'd (e.g. Reform's). M-tier claims now always link to each party's OWN canonical manifesto/plan page (source_type 'manifesto' — the party's own words, not a third-party source). Applied at build time (overrides M-cited claims in existing verdicts — no re-run) and in run_verdict.evidence_units for future runs. The model never sees this metadata, so party-blindness holds. URLs verified resolving 2026-06-16 (Reform 403s to bots but serves in-browser).
